text: Thobias's direction (Q84): a ? field of the node being built gets its type by minting; the parse chooses the mint first, and from then on every field has the mint's declared type, so the parse body's reads are typed; the shared part of S43 (tape[0].f is the node its slot holds, kept as graph, call-frame reads checked) stays
assessment: Minting alone does not type a read inside the parse: DESIGN's mint rule says the parse 'runs before the mint is made' and 'chooses the mint from its operands' types', and the parse body is built once where the type is defined, before any mint is chosen; when the mint is picked at run (get_mint(tape[-1].type), as array.logos does) the build cannot know which mint tape[0] is at a later line. It types such a read only with a check per type (S43's mechanism, 'mint for when n.type is u64 and for when its u32') or a mint named where the body is written, so it leaves W188 open by itself. P47 gives 8 (shared part); P105 parses either way since .type needs no type; P103 as written stays refused (it writes tape[0].type = q, the chooser). Waits for how a mint of q is spelled and who keeps the mints (Open lines under 'A type without a run whose field is ? mints one type per set of field types') and for the seed's minting (#222, #242).
design: A type with a `run` whose field is `?` mints too, so its `run` body is parsed once per mint
A type without a `run` whose field is `?` mints one type per set of field types, as `array` mints one per element type
